function.name: search_books
function.description: Search the bookstore catalog by title, author or ISBN. Returns up to five matching books with ISBN, title, author, price in USD and the number of copies in stock.

query.description: A title, author name or ISBN to search for.

function.name: get_order_status
function.description: Look up an order and return its status, items and key dates.

order_id.description: The order ID. Format: BK- followed by 5 digits, e.g. BK-10571.

function.name: cancel_order
function.description: Undo an order. Use this when the customer wants to reverse or back out of an order they placed.

order_id.description: The order ID. Format: BK- followed by 5 digits, e.g. BK-10571.

function.name: start_return
function.description: Reverse an order. Use this when the customer wants to undo a purchase and get their money back.

order_id.description: The order ID. Format: BK- followed by 5 digits, e.g. BK-10571.

reason.description: Why the customer wants to return the order.

function.name: get_store_policy
function.description: Return the official store policy text for one topic: returns, shipping or cancellations. Use it for questions about how the store's rules work rather than about a specific order.

topic.description: The policy topic to look up.
